findings.passage: “If there’s a will, there’s a way,” McClinton told a collection of election officials, advocates, and experts at Dickinson College. “What we lack in Harrisburg, just a few miles from here, is a willingness. We had a way.”
findings.note: Quoted by the Philadelphia Inquirer (published 2025-03-06) at a Carlisle election event on the day the Speaker listed voter ID among policies for an election reform package. The same article says she told the event that pre-canvassing, early voting and voter ID were top priorities, but that sentence is the reporter's, so only her quote is saved.
